The '''Dahvil-Fodro Hyperspace Promenade''' was an illegal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] race that was part of the [[Star Rally]] and was held in the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Racers began on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dahvil]] and then traveled to [[Ord Dorlass]], [[Tintel]] and [[Azna]], before finishing on [[Fodro]]. The race was organized by [[Pann Tefilous]] and racers included the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Siro Simito]] and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Seeg]]. Despite its illegal nature, it was very popular and the racers became rich and famous.
